newsitem.title: FRANCE: SocGen to meet ROE, solvency aims - report.
newsitem.headline: SocGen to meet ROE, solvency aims - report.

text.p: Societe Generale chairman Marc Vienot said in an interview due to appear on Thursday his bank would meet its objective of a six percent tier one Cooke ratio of solvency at the end of 1997.
Vienot, speaking in an interview to be published in Les Echos newspaper, said this was taking into account Credit du Nord, which it has agreed to buy from Paribas.
He also said the group would meet a goal of 10 percent return on equity.
"Of course we will meet our profitability objectives," he was quoted as saying. A copy of the interview was supplied in advance to Reuters.
"It's already been achieved for retail banking. It will take a bit longer for the group as a whole. Our 1996 results will lend credit to those ambitions, I believe," he was quoted as saying.
"Once again, the acquisition of Credit du Nord does not compromise that -- to the contrary in fact," he said. (( -- Paris Newsroom +33 1 4221 5452))
